name: 01_hero_reveal
moment: Before/after (no HUD, ACES re-stage): a wet-vac band cuts top-to-bottom through caked mud plates and loose crumbs on the Anatolian rug and shows vivid red/navy/cream medallions; the wet-vac wand sits on the band's near end with rubble still ahead. Hidden HUD: Clean 28%.

name: 04_scraper_crust
moment: The scraper breaking dried crust plates on the European green rug: two scraped lanes of broken crumbs next to intact plates, a fresh dust puff rising behind the head, crust chunks thrown onto the tiles. Hint 'Scrape the dry crust off' matches the tool.

name: 10_payslip
moment: Pay-slip card after the hand-over: Medium soil 3:08, base + speed bonus + spotless + bone dry + COMBO stamp = $120, rays behind, 'Take a new carpet' button

name: 12_rya_half_clean
moment: Work in progress on the Finnish rya (no HUD, ACES re-stage): the left half extracted and dried to vivid gold/blue/green, a pink foam strip down the boundary, the rotary brush (blue bristles) beside it, the right strip still caked in mud plates. Floor mopped clean. Hidden HUD: Clean 66%.

name: 03_hose_spill
moment: The hose soaking the Salor Turkmen rug: the blue nozzle over a fresh sheet of water with a glossy rim, the wet pile gone dark rich red around it and muddy water lifting out of the grime on the left. Hint 'Wet it down' matches the tool.

name: 17_lamp_moisture
moment: The moisture inspection lamp (Z) late in drying: the scene is dimmed, the dried left part of the European green rug is dark with the dryer's scalloped edge, the still-damp right part glows blue, and the dryer ring sits on the border. HUD Dry 92% with the Z key lit, hint 'Dry it'.

name: 14_handover_flight
moment: The hand-over: the spotless Anatolian rug (the hero shot's rug, finished) has just lifted off, fully intact, under a burst of gold and white sparkles. HUD Clean 100% / Dry 100%, 3:12 par 3:32, hint 'Handed over to the client!'.

name: 11_upgrades_shop
moment: Upgrades shop 'Tune your kit': POWER/AREA pips for all 10 tools, prices, lamps (moisture owned, dirt highlight $400), wallet $1,960 over the dimmed carpet

name: 08_spotless_handover
moment: Finished Transylvanian rug, 100% clean + 100% dry, 'Sparkling clean - hand it over!' and the pulsing Hand over button
